desc: Prove the greedy/order characterization of an optimal pairing and derive the exact feasibility condition for making \(K\) pairs in \([L,R]\).
Precompute \(p_x\) via lower bounds and \(C_x=p_x-x\), then build a sparse table for range maxima.
Establish monotonicity in \(K\) and implement binary search for each query using the range-maximum feasibility predicate.
Check edge cases involving odd interval lengths, equal mochi sizes, sentinel positions, and the exact condition \(2a\le b\).
Validate the complete Python implementation on both provided samples and additional small brute-force cases, with efficient input/output and within complexity bounds.
